Preference will be given to the candidates capable of preparing North Indian, South Indian, Vegetarian and Non-Vegetarian dishes. Helper: 10th Pass from a recognized Board, Knowledge of Urdu. Preference will be given to the candidates having experience in maintenance and cleanliness of Hostels /Canteens or any other large eating-houses.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for MANUU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for MANUU recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview registration is scheduled for 13 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time for registration.

faq.question: Q2. What are the different posts available in MANUU recruitment?
faq.answer: MANUU is recruiting for the posts of Caretaker (Male), Cook, and Helper.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Helper post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Helper post is 10th Pass from a recognized Board, along with knowledge of Urdu.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Caretaker post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Caretaker (Male) post is ₹25,200/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for these positions?
faq.answer: The age limit is preferably below 32 years for all the mentioned posts.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry one passport-size photograph, self-attested photocopies of educational qualifications, proof of age, experience certificate, caste certificate (if applicable), and other relevant documents.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There are a total of 13 vacancies for the posts of Caretakers, Cooks, and Helpers.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Maulana Azad National Urdu University (MANUU) Campus, Gachibowli, Hyderabad, Telangana - 500032.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-in-Interview.
